atomic_cutover: StaffNotice, StaffNoticeAck, their values, validation and repository contract move unchanged from models/users to models/schedule. The timetable composition's LifecycleStaff, ConflictStaffDirectory, DeviationStaff, OperationPeople, CorrectionPeople and LifecycleStudents ports return timetable views; the activity rosters keep the People Directory child rows through RosterStudents. The root maps the People Directory rows (NewTimetableStaff, NewTimetableLifecycleStudents and the person adapters) and passes errors through unchanged.
